unit.why: A single narrative: a Lithuanian scholar heckles the Berdichever's sermons, goes to R. Barukh of Medzhybizh to test him, and loses all his learning.

stories.start_quote: בעת שהי׳ הגה״ק מבארדיטשוב דרבו לילך
stories.summary_en: A Lithuanian scholar in Berdichev twice heckles R. Levi Yitzhak's sermons; R. Barukh of Medzhybizh says that if he comes to him he will be unable to learn. The scholar comes to test him with an obscure Zohar passage, finds the Zohar already open at that passage, and after R. Barukh's teaching on the angel of forgetting he forgets everything and ends up an ignorant synagogue beadle.
